title: Instrument conditional KV warmup and prefetch success-funnel dashboard
author: Daniel Park
body:
Summary: Add conditional KV warmup instrumentation, a prefetch/policy success-funnel dashboard, and alert tuning to reduce noisy SLO alerts. Motivation: We see a tail of requests that suffer cold KV cache penalties; teams manually instrumented ad-hoc warmup logic in several services. This PR centralizes metricization of conditional warmup behavior, surfaces the warm/cold split in token-level cost and latency, and introduces a small dashboard + tuned alert rules to avoid noisy pagers while catching regressions that reflect increased cold cache rates.

What I changed (single string):
- New metrics: observability.prefetch.kv_warmup.attempt, .success, .success_latency_ms (histogram), .policy_decision (enum label: always/policy/none), .windowed_cold_fraction (gauge). These are emitted by the serving runtime when a conditional prefetch policy evaluates and when a KV warmup completes.
- Token-level augmentation: spans now include warmup.tag=(warm|cold|prefetched) and warmup.tokens_saved which allows attribution of cost/latency to warmup effectiveness in the token cost aggregator.
- Dashboard: dashboards/prefetch/conditional-warmup-funnel.json — three panels: funnel (policy hits -> warmup attempts -> warmup successes -> cold completions), warm/cold token latency CDF, token-cost delta timeseries (prefetched vs cold).
- Alerts: alerts/prefetch/quieted_cold_spike_rule.yaml — alerts trigger only when cold_fraction rises above baseline and sustained for 5 minutes AND median warmup success_rate < 60% to avoid noise from expected schedule-driven spikes. Added an experimental dedupe label tenure.
- Tests: unit tests for metric tagging and a small integration harness that simulates warmup vs cold requests and verifies histogram buckets and token-cost annotation.
- Docs: docs/observability/conditional_kv_warmup.md with usage, query examples, and runbook linking to incident playbook INC-2026-02.

Checklist:
- [x] Metrics instrumented and exported (prom/otel)
- [x] Dashboard panels + descriptions added
- [x] Alerts tuned and smoke-tested in staging
- [x] Unit and integration tests added
- [x] Docs & runbook updates

Commits (summary):
- c1a19f2: add runtime hooks for conditional KV warmup evaluation and emit base metrics
- 5e8b1a4: attach warmup tags to spans and token cost annotator changes
- 9d7c3b6: add dashboard JSON and grafana panel templates + queries
- f2b4ea0: add alert rule and staged silence logic; add unit/integration tests
- 7c6d2f1: docs and runbook; address review comments; CI fixes

Files changed (high level):
- runtime/prefetch/conditional_warmup.go (instrumentation and policy hooks)
- runtime/telemetry/span_enricher.go (warmup tags added)
- observability/metrics/prefetch_metrics.proto (schema additions)
- dashboards/prefetch/conditional-warmup-funnel.json (new)
- alerts/prefetch/quieted_cold_spike_rule.yaml (new)
- tests/prefetch/warmup_harness_test.go (integration)
- docs/observability/conditional_kv_warmup.md (new)
- observability/collectors/token_cost_aggregator.go (cost attribution to warm/cold flows)
- Makefile / CI pipeline tweak to include new integration harness
- examples/prefetch/quickstart.md (how to enable policy in Dedicated)

Review conversation (condensed):
- Priya Kapoor (review): "Nice end-to-end work here. Two questions: 1) Can we avoid high-cardinality labels on the warmup.tags? 2) The alert uses a 5 minute window — can we add a short cooldown to avoid flipping during deploys?"
- Author (Daniel): "Answered: warmup.tag is low-cardinality (warm/cold/prefetched) and warmup.tokens_saved is numeric. Added dedupe tenure label and a 10m cooldown block in the rule. Updated docs to call out cardinality considerations."
- Liam Chen (review): "Tests look good; add a small tolerance to the synthetic harness to avoid flaky buckets."
- Author: "Added tolerance and a retry-based assertion in the harness. Also added a smoke job in staging to validate the alert gating logic."
- Sofia Martinez (approval): "Looks good once CI is green; small nits addressed."

CI summary:
- build: pass
- unit tests: pass (coverage maintained)
- integration-tests/prefetch-harness: pass after adding retry tolerance
- lint: pass (fixed comment formatting and proto ordering)
- e2e: skipped for this change (dashboard + metrics only); staging smoke job passed

Merge: Squash-merged to main on 2026-02-18. Commit message: "Add conditional KV warmup instrumentation, dashboard and tuned alerts (ENG-2211)"

Follow-ups and monitoring plan:
- Rollout: feature gated by runtime flag; staged to 10% of tenants in staging for 48h, then 30% in blue-green, monitor warmup.success_rate and token-cost delta.
- Observability: added a lightweight SLO dashboard with warm/cold split and an alert suppression rail. After 72h we'll evaluate false positive rate and instrument additional telemetry in the aggregator if needed.
- Next PRs: add ML-driven policy suggestions in Redwood Optimize and a dedicated trace sampler to capture a sample of warmup failure stack traces (ENG-2233).

Release notes: "Added conditional KV warmup telemetry and dashboard to help teams measure and tune prefetch effectiveness. Includes alert with noise-reduction gating. See docs/observability/conditional_kv_warmup.md for queries and runbook."
